head: WORKTREE
summary: Bounded retries and DLT handler built once in messaging-support and wired per service; ITs against real Kafka prove parking, key, partition, headers and that the partition moves on. Defaults documented in ADR 0013 and match application.yml (500+1000+2000 ms = 3.5 s). Only minor test-proof gaps.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: DeadLettersTest#malformedMessageGoesStraightToTheDeadLetterTopic and declaredValidationErrorGoesStraightToTheDeadLetterTopic (recovered on first handleOne); ITs invalidCommandIsParked, replyForAnUnknownPaymentIsParked, replyWithoutMessageIdIsParked
ledgerflow.kafka.retry.* in both application.yml; defaults in ADR 0013 Retries section

findings.description: The ITs show a validation-error record lands on the DLT but not that retries were skipped; that is proven only by the unit test with a stand-in exception, not with the real InvalidTransactionException/PaymentNotFoundException classification.
findings.suggestion: Add a unit test in each service asserting its NOT_RETRYABLE list makes the handler recover on the first attempt, or count listener invocations in the IT.

findings.description: The byte[] template routing for undeserialisable records is covered only by the ITs, not at unit level.
findings.suggestion: Optional: unit test with a byte[] value asserting it goes through rawBytes.
